persona.label: Zonal Manager — Batch Schedule Review
persona.frequency: all day, primary admin user; reviews at own Schedule Cadence (daily/alternate-day/weekly/on-demand), not a fixed morning gate

goals: Monitor auto-dispatched Plant-wise Batch Assignments (spot-check AUTO_ASSIGNED vs OVERRIDDEN, see Recommender reasoning) without a forced approval step
Override a dispatched batch or in-shift Day Plan at any time — swap SE, split batch, remove/defer/reorder Tickets — safely around ON_SITE work, reason-coded
Shape future dispatch via SE Planner (plant-vs-date bias signal) and resolve the manual-assignment fallback when retries exhaust
scopeNote: PRD Flow 10 (SE Management) houses the SE Planner grid alongside SE availability/leave admin, not inside Flow 2's Batch Schedule pages — unclear if SE Planner is this module or SE Management's. Flow 3's system-triggered CRITICAL insertion queue also straddles Scheduling (Intra-day Re-plan, CONTEXT.md) and a separate notification/queue surface (Intra-day Queue page). Recorded, not resolved.

capabilities.name: Batch dispatch monitoring list (SE, batch count, date range, AUTO_ASSIGNED/OVERRIDDEN badge)
capabilities.why: dispatch is already live for the SE; without this list the ZM has no way to prioritise spot-checks and bad Recommender output runs unnoticed all day

capabilities.name: Batch Schedule Detail with override controls (swap SE, split batch, remove Ticket, reorder, defer)
capabilities.why: only mechanism to correct a Recommender suggestion against field reality before the SE wastes a trip

capabilities.name: "Why suggested?" reasoning panel (Company Tier, Device Bucket, Priority Rank, Plant Cluster Multiplier)
capabilities.why: without visible reasoning the ZM overrides blind, either rubber-stamping bad batches or over-correcting good ones

capabilities.name: ON_SITE-aware override warning with mandatory reason code
capabilities.why: an override that silently yanks a Ticket while the SE is physically on-site strands the visit and leaves no audit trail for why

capabilities.name: Schedule Cadence reminder (configurable, advisory-only, no lock)
capabilities.why: with no nudge the ZM misses their own review window and a mis-dispatched batch sits unspotted for days

capabilities.name: SE Planner multi-day grid (plant-vs-date, feeds Recommender as bias signal)
capabilities.why: without forward plant-visit intent the ZM is purely reactive, only ever correcting after the Recommender has already committed a batch

capabilities.name: Manual same-day Day Plan update (add/remove/reorder Tickets mid-shift, no SE Acceptance)
capabilities.why: field conditions change faster than the next batch cycle; ZM needs live control of the current Day Plan, not just next-cycle override

capabilities.name: Manual assignment fallback (3-retry exhaustion queue -> AVAILABLE-SE-only assign modal)
capabilities.why: an escalated CRITICAL Ticket with no action surface is a dead end — fleet uptime SLA keeps bleeding until a human assigns it

capabilities.name: Push/in-app notification to SE on new batch, override, or same-day update
capabilities.why: Ravi's day plan changes underneath him; app has no polling, so a missed push means he works a stale or wrong plan

capabilities.name: Ordered, plant-clustered Day Plan view (stop sequence, device count/stop, Zone Warehouse pickup step)
capabilities.why: this is Ravi's entire day; without plant-ordered stops he re-plans his own route manually and the clustering travel-savings the Recommender computed are lost
